verdict.rationale: Okta documents SCIM as a defined schema/RESTful API for CRUD provisioning of users and groups into downstream apps, and provides a developer guide for building SCIM integrations, directly supporting the core capability. However, evidence lacks detail on real-time push timing, entitlement-level provisioning (beyond users/groups), or independent hands-on confirmation of automatic downstream sync at the moment access is assigned. Missing for 10: entitlement-push evidence, real-time/automatic sync confirmation, independent/hands-on validation of SCIM behavior in production.
